diagnosis: Finite closed solid ends with 128um external field margins; all lateral external boundaries are impermeable/free-slip. x=0 is half-width mirror symmetry; x=248um is a second symmetry boundary (finite pitch). No periodic y.

Gravity -y: bottom end y=0, top end y=L; lighter depleted electrolyte rises toward +y. beta=0.15 L/mol (explicit; 0.07 was the run_tile default when the first run was made, 0.15 is the unified value).

Profiles subtract actual initial highest psi=0 crossings. Floor is x=4um; field is the mean of x>200um columns. Ten samples start at least 3dx from each end. Dense floor profiles include column envelopes under grown end walls; final height above -40um flags end-wall encroachment, excluded from regional floor means. Top/bottom are 10%-length averages, middle is the central 10%.

End zone is distance from each end to first floor thickness within 1% of middle; centre distances have dx uncertainty and this is a threshold diagnostic, not an exponential fit. Convection-only zone subtracts no-flow and its middle contrast.
No volume correction or solver patches. Native flow update_every=5, moving field-mean bulk-plane lid. Maximum sampled speed is max absolute cell component at saved frame times.

Faraday volume errors are +2.248% without flow and +2.315% with axial flow on this grid, a numerical accuracy caveat; no volume correction was used. Large envelope gains in the first end columns are end-wall advance, not 80um of deposited floor copper.
postprocessing: Dense saved profiles re-sampled at >=3dx from ends; encroached columns excluded from regional floor means. No integration rerun.
